caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with five visible drawers, each decorated with intricate floral and scrollwork patterns in muted colors primarily featuring dark brown, black, red, and green tones. The chest has a rectangular shape with a slightly overhanging top and a base with trim detail. The front face of the drawers displays symmetrical floral designs, incorporating stylized leaves, stems, and flower forms. The right side of the chest features a large vertical floral motif with a prominent tulip-like flower and smaller dangling blossoms in shades of yellow, orange, red, and green, framed by a decorative border. The chest stands alone against a plain, light beige background, with the perspective slightly angled to show both the front and the right side of the piece.
title: Painted Chest of Drawers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
